name: Crunchy Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter
ingredients: Roasted Peanut 72% (Peanut Butter and Peanut Chunks), Dark Chocolate Compound 20% (Sugar, Vegetable Palm Oil, Cocoa Solids & Emulsifier (Lecithin, Polyglycerol Polyricinoleate), Natural Flavours), Sugar, Emulsifier and Stabiliser (Mono & diglycerides of fatty acids), Salt, Hydrogenated Soyabean Oil
